title: Codex & Claude Code Usage Limits: One File Changed My Quota
description:
Codex & Claude Code usage limits: does your setup actually matter? I ran the same feature through both tools, a default setup and a configured one, and tracked what each quota did and whether the feature still worked.

I'm NOT ranking Codex vs Claude Code. Their meters aren't comparable. The question is whether YOUR setup matters inside each tool.

Test it yourself: pick one feature, write the checks first, run each setup 2 times, compare, and make sure it still works.
